notes.title: La Maledizione dell'Uccello Serpente Release Candidate
notes.notes:
La Maledizione dell'Uccello Serpente is in the final stage of testing; the changes introduced in recent weeks are many.

1. new maps
Among which: two secret passages, connections between the wings of the monastery, etc. etc.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41658502/25e5c7a87003fc688b52c29e272343aa52ce3e45.png

2. a poker minigame
It seems that the monks have organized a clandestine gambling den.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41658502/7d1778b5fbe66c26b5b6348b9339b6ba3d08a717.png

3. aesthetic improvements
Wearing armor of iron, ancient bone or wearing the mythical Veste Rossa is reflected in the appearance of the characters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41658502/5b8157f28a9bf1f3ed102bd0ab3b5bbfc78c3a2c.png

4. improvements in the Relic
Changes to the graphics of the Relic both in a state of rest and in the moment of holding it; Furthermore, using the Relic in battle has its own animation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41658502/25ea36b1ebb733ad1a562b6754a243d1054a708c.jpg

5. Bug fixing minor fixes and improvements in many maps.



Pay attention: with the latest update a change has been introduced that invalidates saves made with previous versions of the game.
The change concerns the equipment of armor, which passes from the head, body, accessory types to the types: head, body, accessory, footwear, gloves.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41658502/4f4a7b2e2f0930b7f555508a8a88935ecb37c1ae.png
The error in the case of previous saves occurs when trying to equip footwear or gloves.
If the game crashes when equipping, the only option is to start a game from scratch.
I apologize for the inconvenience, but it was not possible to save the previous one and I felt that the upgrade to the equipment was worth it.
